decides: It supports the current page's framing that bone conduction is the budget choice for awareness and swimming, not a premium one. On 2026-11-17 MOJAWA's store has the Run Plus from $99.99 and the swim-rated Purra Swim at $169.99. Keep the Run Plus as the budget bone-conduction pick and the Purra Swim as the swim pick.
